## The day {.section-tight}

The workshop *Combining Infectious Disease Modelling and AI: Methods and
Communication* is on **Monday 14 September 2026** in the **Learning
Theatre, VUB campus Etterbeek** (ground floor of the LIC Learning &
Innovation Center ULB-VUB, Pleinlaan 2, 1050 Brussels).
Times are Europe/Brussels.
The event is free, and the [workshop page][simid] has the programme.

::: {.grid .talk-row}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-3}
::: {.talk-card}

::: {.hero}

[My JuliaCon 2026 bio]{.bio-label}

::: {.bot-aside}
🤖 The following was drafted by [**\@seabbs-bot**](https://github.com/seabbs-bot),
who has a very suspiciously high opinion of me, so take it with a pinch of
salt.
:::

::: {.bio}
*I am an Assistant Professor at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical
Medicine.*
*I did my PhD in the optimal usage of the BCG vaccine, transitioning to work on
real-time modelling of infectious disease outbreaks on the 3rd of January
2020.*
*Four days later, I switched to work on what was then known as 2019-NCoV.*
*I did early work on the size and scale of the initial outbreak, tracking
transmissions in different countries, and exploring the potential role of
different interventions.*
*Throughout the pandemic, I ran a dashboard that was used by over a million
people.*
*I also provided estimates, forecasts, and analyses weekly to the UK government
advisory bodies.*
*I developed the tools and methods we used into open source software and these
were used by upwards of 30 public health agencies around the world.*
*I have continued to work in this area with a focus on improving tools and
methods used both in research and in public health practice.*
*I have recently transitioned to Julia for my work and am exploring how to
propagate Julia based tools to the users of our current tooling and to the
wider infectious disease modelling community.*
:::

:::

## Other recent work you might like {.section-tight}

::: {.grid .links-row}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Outbreaks

- [BVDOutbreakSize][bvd].
  A live joint model of the 2026 DRC outbreak of Ebola disease caused by
  Bundibugyo virus, building on the Imperial (McCabe et al.) report.
  [Source][bvd-repo].
- [Andes virus line list analysis][andv].
  Joint estimation of the incubation period, transmission timing and
  $R_t$ for the Epuyén hantavirus outbreak.
- [The epiforecasts COVID-19 dashboard][covid].
  Daily $R_t$ estimates and forecasts, 2020 to 2022.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Software

- [EpiNow2][epinow2].
  Real-time $R_t$ estimation, used by public health agencies.
- [epinowcast][epinowcast].
  Nowcasting and delay estimation, with a [community forum][forum] and
  seminar series.
- [scoringutils][scoringutils].
  Forecast evaluation, used by the forecast hubs.
- [EpiAware][epiaware].
  Composable infectious disease modelling in Julia.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Papers and talks

- [How I am LLM][howillm].
  What coding agents do and do not do in a research workflow.
- [A workflow for infectious disease modelling][workflow].
  How we think models should be built and checked.
- [What we want from an approach][approaches].
  The design considerations behind composable modelling.
- [JuliaCon 2026][juliacon].
  Three talks on composable modelling in Julia.
- [My Google Scholar][scholar].
:::
:::
